'''FatLump''' was a member of the technology-hating [[Meatlumps|Meatlump gang]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], this [[Graffiti/Legends|graffiti]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]] created many of the graffiti used by the Meatlumps to mark their territory.<ref name="SWG:MTP" />

==Behind the scenes==
FatLump was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MTP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> FatLump was mentioned during the "[[W:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]," added to the game with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>

Players could purchase various Meatlump items from a [[:w:c:swg:Meatlump Vendor|vendor]] in the [[Meatlump Hideout]], including a number of graffiti that could be used to decorate the players' [[:w:c:swg:Housing|virtual homes]]. The description text of all of these graffiti mentioned that they were made by FatLump.<ref name="SWG:MTP" />
